    ↓
Split In Batches (batch size = 10)
    ↓
HTTP Request (打對方 API)  ← 開 Retry on fail, 5000ms

entries.en:
Google Sheets (read 500 rows)
    ↓
Split In Batches (batch size = 10)
    ↓
HTTP Request (call their API)  <- Retry on fail enabled, 5000ms
    ↓
Wait (1 second)
    ↓
(back to Split In Batches for the next batch)
